scoring_justification: The critical shear stress can be recomputed deterministically from the agent's raw CSV using the same model equations and published parameters. T1 is feasible because the model is analytical and no external hidden labels are required.

output_contract.notes: The checker will independently implement the same energy model with identical parameters and recompute τc for each L'. The agent's reported τc values must match within a tolerance that accounts for numerical solver differences. The load-bearing design ensures the agent must actually run the model and cannot guess the τc values.
